title: Gemini Notebook can now turn your research into interactive websites
summary: This tool just keeps getting better and better.
body: Credit: Shimul Sood / Android Authority TL;DR Google Gemini Notebook can now turn your research sources into interactive websites to help you understand complex information. Users can create visual explainers, interactive dashboards, and project management trackers by typing “make me a site” and describing what they need. The feature is now rolling out globally to web users, with mobile support coming soon. Google is making Gemini Notebook more useful for understanding complex topics and organizing research notes with a new interactive websites feature.
